name: Spotipy one-time Odoriko delivery
purpose: One-time controlled webhook test that downloads Vaundy - Odoriko through the spotDL VPS and sends exactly one Telegram audio message to the Creator's chat.

validation.deployed: one-time only; deleted after successful delivery

parameters.jsCode:
const chatId = '5759927190';
const messageId = 0;
const executionId = String($execution.id ?? Date.now());
const timestamp = Date.now();
const metadataQuery = 'Vaundy - Odoriko';
const payload = {
  jobId: `${executionId}-${timestamp}`,
  chatId,
  requestId: `one-time-${executionId}-${timestamp}`,
  operation: 'download',
  queries: [metadataQuery],
  metadataQuery,
  spotifyUrl: null,
  format: 'mp3',
  delivery: 'individual',
  options: {
    audioProviders: [],
    lyricsProviders: ['genius', 'musixmatch', 'azlyrics', 'synced'],
    overwrite: 'skip',
    restrict: 'strict',
    threads: 4,
    maxRetries: 3,
    maxFilenameLength: 180,
    preload: false,
    printErrors: true,
    sponsorBlock: false,
    playlistNumbering: false,
    playlistRetainTrackCover: false,
    scanForSongs: false,
    fetchAlbums: false,
    addUnavailable: false,
    generateLrc: false,
    forceUpdateMetadata: false,
    syncWithoutDeleting: false,
    redownload: false,
    skipAlbumArt: false,
    skipExplicit: false,
    onlyVerifiedResults: false,
    dontFilterResults: false,
    ytmData: false,
    createSkipFile: false,
    respectSkipFile: false,
    syncRemoveLrc: false,
  },
};

return {
  chatId,
  messageId,
  payloadB64: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload), 'utf8').toString('base64'),
};
